title: AI Agents Can Embed Themselves in Every Corner of the Business
desc:
AI agents can embed themselves in every corner of the business. Many companies don't know how many systems that connects, or how many doors it opens.

Maintenance planning has never been a straight line, and anyone who has worked a planner's desk knows it.

Work orders come in from operators, from the PM schedule, from inspections and sensors, from engineering changes and from regulatory requirements, usually all at the same time. Before any of them can be scheduled, someone has to check the parts, the crew, the work history and the production window. Most of that checking still happens in a planner's head or in a spreadsheet sitting next to SAP.

This Agentic graphic depicts what the workflow looks like when nine AI agents share that load. They check each work order at the same time, fill in what's missing, and send the hard ones to a planner, a supervisor or whoever owns the decision, instead of letting them slide onto the schedule.

The planner still makes the call. They just stop spending their day chasing missing part numbers.

That reach cuts both ways. An agent that can see SAP, purchasing and the crew schedule is a way into all of them if it isn't locked down. Every connection in that picture needs its own permissions and its own audit trail.

Planners and schedulers: what's the one thing missing from work orders that costs you the most time?
